The '''Battle of Merson''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] consisted of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ronhar Kim]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tap-Nar-Pal]] and Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], being sent into battle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merson]].

==The battle==
[[File:Merson.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The battle rages on.]]
[[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] underestimated the forces on the planet by a factor of five, and were crushed. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] had expected the attack due to information given by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], warning that the Republic would be arriving shortly.<ref name="SWR64" /> As a consequence, the local [[Merson pirates/Legends|Merson pirate]] forces were augmented with CIS droids and material.<ref name="CSWE" />

Captain Pellaeon withdrew upon the arrival of additional [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces and Master Ronhar Kim, his Padawan and their army perished on the planet below. Kim's Padawan attempted a strafing run to assist his master, only to be shot down by [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]].<ref name="SWR64" />

==Aftermath==
With the death of Jedi Master Kim, his plan for testing the members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for high [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] counts died with him. Thus, Chancellor Palpatine's secret identity as Darth Sidious continued to remain a secret.<ref name="SWR64" />
